notes: Whole source image dimensions are 2369 x 1686 pixels. Half a is 1244 x 1686; half b is 1245 x 1686. Whole, a and b were each viewed once, followed by seven distinct tight crops viewed once each. No OCR, recognition software, web research, parallel published text, other scans or other readers were used.

The upper portion contains a graded series of subdivided segments, strips and hatched lens-like complexes, separated by two long curves. Below them are five parenthesized category names and two short formulas. These are observations of the page; no mathematical interpretation of the sketches is certified.

The first relation is read as a hooked left arrow because the crop shows a detached left-pointing head. This differs from H and from C's preferred alternative. The heavier second arrow also has a genuine right hook.

The earlier curved sign under the heavy arrow, the underlying Ord, and the case of o/O in Préord remain uncertain. The first-lens loops remain graphically present without a certified word count. Border-mark origin is also unresolved.

Maquettes is written above cancelled Triang. The abbreviation is not expanded. No date, title or manuscript folio is present. The isolated bottom-left 1 is recorded as the archive sheet number, not as a manuscript page macro.
No explicit author doubt in words was found. The curled hatch marks and retracing are not silently interpreted as question marks. No mathematical slip is asserted from this page alone.
The formula letters following F are at the baselines of their respective F stems, not subscripts; the line itself rises. Both shallow curves under the bottom x and y are retained.

H_drawing.tex was read after the two half views when the parent identified it as an authorized page witness. It was compared with the same already-viewed source geometry; no additional full or half view was made.

C's TikZ geometry was reused after element-by-element comparison. The only changes inside that drawing are removal of the unjustified one-word illegibility label and addition of an in-place uncertainty marker for the traced loops. A separate marginal graphic accounts for the lower-right marks.
All main text is handwritten. No typed reuse, printed title, reverse-side text or separate written marginal note was found. Large blank regions were inspected in the whole and half views.

brief_feedback: The instructions do not give a dedicated convention for an uncertain word-versus-scribble distinction or uncertain manuscript-versus-reproduction edge marks. I preserved the lens loops as graphics with a local empty \unsure{} marker and a precise comment, rather than inventing a word count; the edge fragments are preserved graphically with origin left open. The 2200-pixel minimum produces a very tall enlargement for a narrow marginal stack, but it was viewed only once.
